productivity_pay_index.source: Economic Policy Institute, The Productivity-Pay Gap (https://www.epi.org/productivity-pay-gap/). Index 1948Q1 = 100. Q4 values except 1948 (Q1) and 2026 (Q2).

labour_share.source: BLS, The Economics Daily: Labor share at its lowest level, 52.8 percent in second quarter 2026. Nonfarm business sector.

innovator_capture.source: Nordhaus (2004), NBER Working Paper 10433, via NBER Digest 'Who Gains from Innovation?'

wage_growth_tracker.source: Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Wage Growth Tracker, 3-month moving average of median wage growth. 2022 peak via YCharts.

ssa_wage_percentiles_2022.source: SSA Wage Statistics for 2022 (https://ssa.gov/cgi-bin/netcomp.cgi?year=2022). Percentiles log-interpolated within brackets; 172.0M wage earners.
